content: The Parkinson’s module is designed for movement-related monitoring and care support. Its wearable concept uses ESP32 and MPU6050 and is worn on the dorsal side (back side) of the hand. Software concepts include movement/orientation visualization, unusual-movement indicators, fall-event history, alerts, and rehabilitation activity support.

The Parkinson’s software concept includes motion and orientation visualization, review of tremor or unusual-movement indicators, fall-event history, timestamps, and rehabilitation activity records. Discussed software direction: Django backend, SQLite, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend. No verified accuracy figure is available.

Neuro Mates is an AI- and IoT-enabled smart-care project focused on Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, Epilepsy, and physiotherapy support for paralysis-related movement limitations and Parkinson’s. It combines sensor-based monitoring, software workflows, alerts, reminders, activity records, and interactive rehabilitation support.

The Parkinson’s wearable concept uses an ESP32 controller and MPU6050 accelerometer/gyroscope. It is worn on the dorsal side (back) of the hand with an adjustable strap. Fingers, thumb, palm, and wrist remain free. Do not describe it as a smartwatch, palm device, or forearm band.

The Parkinson’s alert flow is movement monitoring, sensor-data analysis, a potentially concerning event, WhatsApp notification and/or siren, then continued monitoring and status confirmation where implemented. An alert is not a diagnosis and does not guarantee fall or tremor detection.

Q: Which conditions does Neuro Mates focus on? A: Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, Epilepsy, and physiotherapy support for paralysis-related movement limitations and Parkinson’s. This does not mean the system treats or cures these conditions.

Q: What is Neuro Mates? A: An AI- and IoT-enabled smart-care project designed to support Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, Epilepsy, and paralysis-focused rehabilitation through monitoring, alerts, reminders, records, and interactive exercise support.
Q: Where is the Parkinson’s wearable worn? A: On the dorsal side, or back side, of the hand. It uses an ESP32 and MPU6050 in the discussed concept.

Neurological conditions and mobility limitations can create ongoing care needs beyond clinic visits. Patients and families may need support with routine monitoring, unusual-event awareness, location safety, reminders, activity records, and communication. Neuro Mates is designed to support selected parts of these everyday workflows.

The physiotherapy module supports interactive rehabilitation exercises for face, hand/fingers, and legs for paralysis-related movement limitations and Parkinson’s. It combines biomedical electrical-signal sensing with game-based exercise interactions and activity records. It does not replace a physiotherapist.

The Caretaker portal is intended for authorized family members or caregivers to receive relevant notifications and follow available patient updates, such as location alerts, movement or EEG-related alerts, reminders, and activity records depending on the module.

A typical workflow is: a wearable or sensor collects a signal; a controller forwards data to software; software processes, visualizes, or records it; relevant alerts or reminders are presented to the patient or authorized caregiver; and authorized users review available records. Exact steps differ by module.

Neuro Mates is a care-support and monitoring project, not a diagnostic or treatment replacement. Do not provide definitive diagnosis, promise prevention, guarantee seizure/fall detection, recommend medication changes, or tell users to ignore urgent symptoms. Direct medical questions to qualified professionals and urgent situations to local emergency services.
Q: Can Neuro Mates replace a doctor or physiotherapist? A: No. Diagnosis, treatment decisions, and rehabilitation planning remain with qualified professionals.

The Epilepsy module is designed around EEG-related signal monitoring, potentially abnormal activity awareness, caregiver notification, and event records. Hardware concept: ESP32 and BioAmp EXG Pill. Wearable concept: lightweight adjustable headband with the specified electrode reference point behind the ear, contacting skin.
